description: Defines an actor 'DiagnosticsFileLog' for managing logging of diagnostic events to a rotating JSON Lines log file, including functions for enabling, directory management, log writing, rotation, and cleanup.

classes.name: DiagnosticsFileLog
classes.description: A concurrency-safe singleton actor for logging diagnostic event records to a file with log rotation, providing static methods to check if logging is enabled and to get log directory/file URLs, and instance methods for logging, clearing logs, and managing file rotation.

methods.name: isEnabled
methods.description: Checks if diagnostics logging is enabled based on UserDefaults setting.

methods.name: logDirectoryURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the directory where logs are stored.

methods.name: logFileURL
methods.description: Returns the URL of the specific log file used for writing records.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a diagnostic event with category, event name, and optional fields.

methods.name: clear
methods.description: Removes all log files and backups, effectively clearing log history.

methods.name: write
methods.description: Encodes a record to JSON and appends it to the log file.

methods.name: ensureDirectory
methods.description: Creates the log directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: append
methods.description: Appends a JSON-encoded record as a line to the log file.

methods.name: rotateIfNeeded
methods.description: Rotates log files if current log exceeds max byte size, maintaining up to maxBackups copies.

methods.name: rotatedURL
methods.description: Constructs a URL for rotated log files based on index.
